qualifications: Draft-proposal feedback can be requested until 11 December 2026

description_short: Northumbria's UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Citizen-Centred AI opened applications for its September 2027 intake on 12 October 2026. Applications close 11 January 2027 at 17:00 GMT; eligible full-time home-fee students receive an enhanced GBP 30,000 annual stipend.

compensation.value: Enhanced annual stipend of GBP 30,000 for eligible full-time home-fee students; standard UKRI rates for others
